arxiv-1902-09859.title: Context Vectors are Reflections of Word Vectors in Half the Dimensions
arxiv-1902-09859.creator: Zhenisbek Assylbekov zhassylbekov@nu.edu.kz
arxiv-1902-09859.description: Abstract This paper takes a step towards theoretical analysis of the relationship between word embeddings and context embeddings in models such as word2vec. We start from basic probabilistic assumptions on the nature of word vectors, context vectors, and text generation. These assumptions are supported either empirically or theoretically by the existing literature.

arxiv-1903-08808.title: Bidirectional Recurrent Models for Offensive Tweet Classification
arxiv-1903-08808.creator: Aleix Cambray Roma, Norbert Podsadowski
arxiv-1903-08808.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Aleix Cambray Roma, Norbert Podsadowski. In this paper we propose four deep recurrent architectures to tackle the task of offensive tweet detection as well as further classification into targeting and subject of said targeting. Our architectures are based on LSTMs and GRUs, we present a simple bidirectional LSTM as a baseline system and then further increase the complexity of the models by adding convolutional layers and implementing a split-process-merge architecture with LSTM and GRU as processors. Multiple pre-processing techniques were also investigated.

arxiv-1907-01353.title: Concepts of work in autonomous quantum heat engines
arxiv-1907-01353.creator: Wolfgang Niedenzu, Marcus Huber, Erez Boukobza
arxiv-1907-01353.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Wolfgang Niedenzu, Marcus Huber, Erez Boukobza. One of the fundamental questions in quantum thermodynamics concerns the decomposition of energetic changes into heat and work. Contrary to classical engines, the entropy change of the piston cannot be neglected in the quantum domain. As a consequence, different concepts of work arise, depending on the desired task and the implied capabilities of the agent using the work generated by the engine. Each work quantifier—from ergotropy to non-equilibrium free energy—has well defined operational interpretations.

arxiv-2105-08146.title: MUSER: MU ltimodal S tress Detection using E motion R ecognition as an Auxiliary Task
arxiv-2105-08146.creator: Yiqun Yao 1 {{1}}, Michalis Papakostas 1 {{1}}, Mihai Burzo 2 {{2}}, Mohamed Abouelenien 3 {{3}}, Rada Mihalcea 1 {{1}}
arxiv-2105-08146.description: Abstract The capability to automatically detect human stress can benefit artificial intelligent agents involved in affective computing and human-computer interaction. Stress and emotion are both human affective states, and stress has proven to have important implications on the regulation and expression of emotion.

arxiv-2106-02499.title: On the prehistory of growth of groups
arxiv-2106-02499.creator: Pierre de la Harpe
arxiv-2106-02499.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pierre de la Harpe. The subject of growth of groups has been active in the former Soviet Union since the early 50’s and in the West since 1968, when articles of Švarc and Milnor have been published, independently. The purpose of this note is to quote a few articles showing that, before 1968 and at least retrospectively, growth of groups has already played some role in various subjects. 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification
20F69.

arxiv-2106-11518.title: AGB interlopers in YSO catalogues hunted out by NEOWISE
arxiv-2106-11518.creator: Jeong-Eun Lee, Sieun Lee, Seonjae Lee, Kyung-Won Suh, Se-Hyung Cho, Do-Young Byun, Wooseok Park, Gregory Herczeg, Carlos Contreras Peña, Doug Johnstone
arxiv-2106-11518.description: Abstract AGBs and YSOs often share the same domains in IR color-magnitude or color-color diagrams leading to potential mis-classification. We extracted a list of AGB interlopers from the published YSO catalogues using the periodogram analysis on NEOWISE time series data. YSO IR variability is typically stochastic and linked to episodic mass accretion.

arxiv-2205-10643.description: Abstract Although supervised deep learning has revolutionized speech and audio processing, it has necessitated the building of specialist models for individual tasks and application scenarios. arxiv-2303-06324.title: OCCL : a Deadlock-free Library for GPU Collective Communication Conference: arXiv; 2023; arXiv Thanks: ‡ Corresponding author.
arxiv-2303-06324.creator: Lichen Pan, Juncheng Liu, Jinhui Yuan, Rongkai Zhang, Pengze Li, Zhen Xiao ‡
arxiv-2303-06324.description: Abstract . Various distributed deep neural network (DNN) training technologies lead to increasingly complicated use of collective communications on GPU. The deadlock-prone collectives on GPU force researchers to guarantee that collectives are enqueued in a consistent order on each GPU to prevent deadlocks.

arxiv-2311-06556.title: A survey on skein modules via braids
arxiv-2311-06556.creator: Ioannis Diamantis
arxiv-2311-06556.description: Abstract . In this paper we present recent results on the computation of skein modules of 3-manifolds using braids and appropriate knot algebras. Skein modules generalize knot polynomials in S 3 S^{3} to knot polynomials in arbitrary 3-manifolds and they have become extremely essential algebraic tools in the study of 3-manifolds.

arxiv-2312-09925.title: CNC-Net: Self-Supervised Learning for CNC Machining Operations
arxiv-2312-09925.creator: Mohsen Yavartanoo, Sangmin Hong, Reyhaneh Neshatavar, Kyoung Mu Lee
arxiv-2312-09925.description: Abstract CNC manufacturing is a process that employs computer numerical control (CNC) machines to govern the movements of various industrial tools and machinery, encompassing equipment ranging from grinders and lathes to mills and CNC routers. However, the reliance on manual CNC programming has become a bottleneck, and the requirement for expert knowledge can result in significant costs.

arxiv-2404-02005.title: homology of conductor
arxiv-2404-02005.creator: Mohsen Asgharzadeh
arxiv-2404-02005.description: Abstract . We study some homological properties of the conductor ideal. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 13B22; 13D45. 1. Introduction The main theme of this paper is about of the ideal of definition of the normal locus: \operatorname{Var}(\mathfrak{C}):=\{\mathfrak{p}\in\operatorname{Spec}(R):R_{\mathfrak{p}}\emph{isnotnormal}\}, if it is exists. Under some mild conditions, for example the analytically unramified condition, it is closed in Zariski topology.

arxiv-2502-09304.creator: Yiqian Huang, Shiqi Zhang, Xiaokui Xiao
arxiv-2502-09304.description: Abstract . Graph-RAG constructs a knowledge graph from text chunks to improve retrieval in Large Language Model (LLM)-based question answering. pmc-12579693.creator: Christabel Thembela Dube, Gokce Oguz, Yasmin Hui Binn Ong, Samydurai Sudhagar, Shyam Prabhakar, Matthew Ronshaugen, Adaikalavan Ramasamy, Chin Yan Lim, Kimberly A Mace

pmc-13256694.title: Clinical Significance of Neutrophil-to-Lymphocyte Ratio and Lymphocyte-to-Monocyte Ratio in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-13256694.creator: Alina Ormenisan, Cecilia Petrovan, Adina Simona Coșarcă, Mihai Vlad Golu, Gabriela Felicia Beresescu, Mădălina Conțiu, Andreea Păcurar, Despina Luciana Bereczki-Temistocle
pmc-13256694.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) remains a significant global health concern, characterized by high morbidity and mortality, particularly in advanced stages. Increasing evidence suggests that systemic inflammation plays a critical role in tumor progression and patient outcomes. This retrospective cohort study aimed to evaluate the prognostic value of systemic inflammatory markers—specifically the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio (LMR)—in correlation with histopathological parameters in patients with OSCC.

uslaw-usc-t11-s701.title: 11 U.S.C. § 701 — Interim trustee
uslaw-usc-t11-s701.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t11-s701.description: United States Code, Title 11 (Bankruptcy); Chapter 7 (Liquidation); Subchapter I (Officers And Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) (1) Promptly after the order for relief under this chapter, the United States trustee shall appoint one disinterested person that is a member of the panel of private trustees established under section 586(a)(1) of title 28 or that is serving as trustee.

uslaw-usc-t16-s460p1.title: 16 U.S.C. § 460p–1 — Designation of area; acreage limitation; boundaries; publication in Federal Register
uslaw-usc-t16-s460p1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s460p1.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LXXIV (Spruce Knob-Seneca Rocks National Recreation Area). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of Agriculture (hereinafter called the “Secretary”) shall— (1) designate as soon as practicable after September 28, 1965, the Spruce Knob-Seneca Rocks National Recreation Area within and adjacent to, and as a part.
